item.title: Jazz Guitar Legend John Scofield on Combo 73, His Friendship with Miles, and more
item.description: The word ‘legend’ can mean many things. item.title: Of Monsters and Men Captivate at Two Night Palace Theater Run
item.description: Of Monsters and Men returned to the Twin Cities for a two-night run at Saint Paul’s Palace Theatre. The historic, semi-restored venue was the perfect setting for an evening of beautiful soundscapes.
